title: Set 309

sentences.ko: 거기 테이블마다 다 노트북 하는 사람이 앉아 있어서, 커피 들고 바보처럼 두 바퀴나 돌다가 결국 그냥 차에서 마셨어.
sentences.text: Every table in that place had somebody on a laptop, so I walked around twice holding my coffee like an idiot, and then I just ended up drinking it in the car.

alts.text: Literally every table had someone on a laptop, so I did two laps with my coffee like an idiot and ended up drinking it in the car.
Every table in that café was occupied by someone working on a laptop, so I walked around twice holding my coffee, feeling rather foolish, and in the end I drank it in my car.

sentences.note: **ended up** 은 원래 그럴 생각은 아니었는데 결국 ~하게 됐다는 뜻이에요. 캐주얼의 **did two laps** 는 한 자리를 빙빙 두 바퀴 돌았다는 말이에요.

sentences.ko: 토요일에 다시 전화한다고 했던 거 아는데, 주말 내내 폰 꺼 놓고 그냥 자고 영화만 봤어. 근데 솔직히 나한테 딱 필요했던 주말이었어.
sentences.text: I know I said I'd call you back on Saturday, but I turned my phone off and just slept and watched movies all weekend, and honestly, it was exactly what I needed.

alts.text: Yeah, I said I'd call you back Saturday, but I shut my phone off and basically slept and watched movies all weekend. Honestly? Exactly what I needed.
I am aware that I said I would return your call on Saturday, but I turned my phone off and spent the entire weekend sleeping and watching films, and to be honest, it was exactly what I needed.

sentences.note: **call you back** 은 못 받은 전화나 미뤄 둔 통화를 다시 걸어 준다는 말이에요. **exactly what I needed** 는 나한테 딱 필요했던 것이라는 뜻으로 자주 써요.
sentences.situation: 주말에 아무것도 안 하고 쉰 게 좋았다고 말하기

sentences.ko: 사실 나 이제 가 봐야 돼. 옆집 사람한테 열 시까지 그 집 개 좀 밖에 내보내 주기로 했는데, 지난번에 깜빡했거든. 또 늦으면 나 진짜 죽었어.
sentences.text: I should get going, actually. I told my neighbor I'd let her dog out by ten, and I forgot last time, so if I'm late again she's going to kill me.

alts.text: Gotta run, actually. Told my neighbor I'd let her dog out by ten, and I forgot last time, so if I'm late again she's gonna kill me.
I am afraid I should be leaving. I told my neighbor I would let her dog out by ten, and I forgot last time, so if I am late again she will be very upset with me.

sentences.note: **I should get going** 은 이제 슬슬 가 봐야겠다며 자리를 뜰 때 쓰는 말이에요. **let her dog out** 은 개가 볼일을 보게 잠깐 밖에 내보내 준다는 뜻이에요.
sentences.situation: 저녁 모임에서 먼저 일어날 구실 만들기

sentences.ko: 작동은 잘 되는데, 말해 둘 게 있어. 왼쪽 스피커가 가끔 소리가 끊겨. 그래서 40달러만 받는 거야. 그것 때문에 안 산다고 해도 충분히 이해해.
sentences.text: It works fine, but I should tell you the left speaker cuts out sometimes, which is why I'm only asking forty for it. If that's a dealbreaker, I totally get it.

alts.text: Works fine, but heads up, the left speaker cuts out sometimes, that's why I'm only asking forty. If that's a dealbreaker, totally get it.
It works perfectly well, but I should mention that the left speaker occasionally cuts out, which is why I am only asking forty for it. If that rules it out for you, I completely understand.

sentences.note: **cuts out** 은 소리나 신호가 중간중간 끊긴다는 뜻이에요. **dealbreaker** 는 이것 하나 때문에 거래를 접게 되는 결정적인 문제를 말해요.
sentences.situation: 중고로 물건 팔면서 상태 솔직히 말하기

sentences.ko: 회사 그만둘까 계속 생각하는데, 말 꺼내려고 할 때마다 좋은 프로젝트를 주거나 월급을 조금 올려 줘. 그러면 그래, 뭐 그렇게 나쁘진 않나 보다 싶어.
sentences.text: I keep thinking about quitting, but every time I'm about to say something, they hand me a good project or a little raise, and I think, okay, maybe it's not that bad.

alts.text: Quitting's always on my mind, but every time I'm about to bring it up, they hand me a good project or a small raise, and I'm like, okay, maybe it's not that bad.
I continue to consider resigning, but whenever I am about to raise the matter, they give me a good project or a modest raise, and I think that perhaps it is not so bad after all.

sentences.note: **I keep thinking about** 은 어떤 생각이 자꾸 든다는 말이에요. 캐주얼의 **I'm like** 는 속으로 이런 생각이 들었다는 걸 말할 때 구어에서 많이 써요.

reviewed: 3번 한국어: '옆집 사람한테 … 개 밖에 내보내 주겠다고' 는 누구 개인지 흐려서 '그 집 개' 로 고치고 말투를 자연스럽게 다듬음
4번 formal: 'If that is a problem for you' 는 dealbreaker(이것 때문에 안 사게 되는 것)보다 뜻이 약해져서 'If that rules it out for you' 로 고침
4번 한국어: '스피커 때문에 안 사겠다고 해도 완전 이해해' 가 어색해서 '그것 때문에 안 산다고 해도 충분히 이해해' 로 다듬음
